result.summary: The landlord's reply (event 007) doesn't approve or decline anything. It says there was a site meeting with Freya from Riverside Services, quotes are awaited, and they'll follow up on Monday 13 Oct. I left approval 3 pending, put the ticket on hold waiting on the landlord with a 3-day follow-up, sent the tenant a status update that doesn't over-promise, and recorded what we learned in the CRM. This is routine, non-urgent communal work, so it doesn't need escalating.
result.situation: The tenant reported an overgrown communal garden and hedge, and unmaintained land beside the flat that they say was due to be cleared last summer. The landlord was emailed on 11 Oct and replied the same evening: Riverside Services visited the site and quotes for various works are pending. No amount or approval has been given yet. The stage is still landlord_approval.
